brief: Zara compara paquetes de lápices y reparte su mesada.

regional.universal: Uses LittleFounders coins only; no market amounts, places or customs.

en-US.prompt: Two pencils cost 8 coins. How much do 3 packs cost?

feedback.met: You scaled the price by the same factor as the packs.
feedback.not_yet: Not yet. Find the price of one pack first.

feedback.met: Escalaste el precio por el mismo factor que los paquetes.
